mcps.label: Grey
mcps.description: Send an email. Prefer passing 'template' + 'data' to render a predefined, nicely formatted HTML email instead of composing 'text'/'html' manually.

to.description: The email address of the recipient.

subject.description: The subject of the email. Not needed when 'template' is set - the template supplies its own subject.

text.description: The plain-text body of the email. Not needed when 'template' is set - the template supplies its own text body.

html.description: The HTML body of the email. Not needed when 'template' is set.

template.description: Only for meeting summary emails. Name of a predefined email template to render instead of manually composing text/html. Must be one of: 'meeting_summary_a' (summary and highlights from the full transcript only), 'meeting_summary_b' (the same plus next steps, speaker attributed). Omit it for every other email and write 'subject' and 'text' yourself.

data.description: Structured data to render into the template named by 'template'. For 'meeting_summary_a': { meetingName, meetingDate, summary, highlights: [{ topic: string, highlights: [string] }] }. For 'meeting_summary_b': the same fields plus next_steps: [string]. The LLM judge's evaluation is not rendered into the body - it is sent as an attachment.

text.description: The plain-text body. Not needed when 'html' is set.

html.description: The HTML body. Not needed when 'text' is set.

attachments.description: Attachments as { filename, path } or { filename, content, contentType? }.

mcps.label: Telco
mcps.description: Render a predefined meeting email template and return the email's subject, plain-text body and HTML body, ready to be passed to TELCO:send_email_ews. Does not send anything.

meetingName.description: The meeting name, used in the subject and the title.

meetingDate.description: The meeting date, shown under the title and in the subject.

attendees.description: Full names of the attendees, listed as the participants.

highlights.description: The meeting's highlights grouped by topic.

next_steps.description: Next steps the meeting left behind. Rendered by 'meeting_summary_b' only.

mcps.description: Evaluate meeting notes with a Turkish LLM judge prompt. transcript.description: The meeting transcript the notes are judged against. Pass full_meeting_transcript from transcribe_meeting through unchanged.

Pass it whenever the summary attributes statements or next steps to specific speakers, so the judge can verify those attributions instead of marking them unsupported - the combined transcript alone carries no speaker labels.

variant.description: Label of the summarization variant being judged (e.g. 'A', 'B'), echoed back in the output.

meeting_summary.description: 0-100: how well the meeting summary reflects the purpose, developments, decisions and outcomes.

next_steps.description: 0-100: completeness and accuracy of the next steps. Null for variant A because next steps are not evaluated.

topics.description: 0-100: completeness and correct organization of the main topics.

highlights.description: 0-100: whether critical decisions and important points were selected correctly.

overall.description: 0-100: holistic usability score; it cannot exceed the accuracy score.

accuracy.description: 0-100: how well the claims in the notes are supported by the transcript and available speaker recordings.

reasoning.description: A Turkish evaluation of at most 150 words identifying concrete strengths and weaknesses.
